hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Africa, bordering the Bight of Benin, between Benin and Ghana || gently rolling savanna in north; central hills; southern plateau; low coastal plain with extensive lagoons and marshes || stretches through six distinct geographic regions; climate varies from tropical to savanna || Resources: phosphates, limestone, marble, arable land || Exports: gold, refined petroleum, soybeans, phosphates, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: gently rolling savanna in north; central hills; southern plateau; low coastal plain with extensive lagoons and marshes || Western Africa, bordering the Bight of Benin, between Benin and Ghana

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot, humid in south; semiarid in north || hot, dry harmattan wind can reduce visibility in north during winter; periodic droughts

economy.excerpt: low-income West African economy; primarily agrarian economy; has a deep-water port; growing international shipping locale; improving privatization and public budgeting transparency; key phosphate mining industry; extremely high rural poverty || Exports: gold, refined petroleum, soybeans, phosphates, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews (2023) || Industries: phosphate mining, agricultural processing, cement, handicrafts, textiles, beverages

peopleAndCulture.excerpt: French (official, language of commerce), Ewe and Mina (in the south), Kabye (sometimes spelled Kabiye) and Dagomba (in the north) || Christian 42.3%, folk religion 36.9%, Muslim 14%, Hindu <1%, Buddhist <1%, Jewish <1%, other <1%, none 6.2% (2020 est.) || Adja-Ewe/Mina 42.4%, Kabye/Tem 25.9%, Para-Gourma/Akan 17.1%, Akposso/Akebu 4.1%, Ana-Ife 3.2%, other Togolese 1.7%, foreigners 5.2%, no response 0.4% (2013-14 est.)
